name: MENT 3500
title: Technology Innovation and Entrepreneurship
description: An integration of the best business and engineering principles and practices. Identification of customer need, development of technical solution and financial viability. Collaboration between School of Business and School of Engineering, teaching product design process combined with business principals required for any viable startup and enterprise. Experiential nature of course will enable students to go through process of conceiving of a new product, building an MVP, developing a business model and business plan, and testing the market. Students will learn the art of successful pitching and presenting business models to successful entrepreneurs. Taught with ENGR 3500.
requirement_description: Open only to Business majors of junior or higher status. Not open to students who have passed or are taking ENGR 3500.
